item.title: QGA fsfreeze on excluded disks (backup=0) can render a VM unresponsive for up to 60 minutes
item.author: invalid@example.com (dusatvoj)
item.dc:creator: dusatvoj
item.content:encoded:
Hi,​


We encountered a problematic behavior in Proxmox VE snapshot backups that caused a significant availability issue for a running VM.

The problem is that Proxmox freezes all guest filesystems, including those on disks explicitly excluded from the backup (backup=0). If one of those filesystems is affected by slow or stalled I/O, the freeze operation can block for an extended period, potentially leaving other already-frozen filesystems inaccessible and the VM effectively...
